changelog: Modular AM/PM market brief generator with optional yfinance tape + movers lists (Yahoo/TMX examples) and a single best-idea wrap-up.
summary: Generate modular, data-backed market reports (AM/PM) across global assets. Use for daily market briefs, premarket/aftermarket summaries, cross-asset dashboards, sector/asset trend tables, top movers (gainers/losers) blocks, and a single best-idea wrap-up. Designed to be region-agnostic and configurable (tickers/regions/assets).
